shared_elements: dense field of small carved sign-like glyphs
low-relief carving on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces bear rows of small, block-like incised signs arranged in horizontal registers, which is the only real correspondence and is a generic feature of any inscribed monument. A shows an elaborate figural scene at the top \u2014 standing human figures with raised arms flanking a rayed disc, over many long lines of pictorial signs \u2014 whereas B shows only bands of squarish, rounded-cornered glyph blocks with no discernible figures, disc, or scene.
